name: TLL Nav v1
description: Sticky top nav with TLL wordmark, primary links, theme pill strip, Memberstack-aware auth state (anonymous shows Log in + Sign up, members show avatar + account link). Used on every public page.

name: TLL Footer v1
description: Global site footer. TLL wordmark, tagline, four link columns (Read, Contribute, About, Legal), Substack newsletter strip, Magnus 🐻‍❄️ sign-off, and meta row. Used on every public page.

name: TLL Sign-Off v1
description: Signed story closer. Required on every published story per brand voice. Rule line plus signature line (writer name, byline location). Reuses tll text-color utilities.

name: TLL Pull Quote v1
description: Large serif pull quote with marigold left rule. Drops into story bodies. Quote text is a prop. Reuses brand display stack and palette tokens.

name: TLL Reader Question v1
description: End-of-story reader prompt on blush card. Label plus question text (prop). Drives comments and engagement.

name: TLL Hashtag Set v1
description: Row of story hashtags (prop) in teal. Closes stories and feeds social/SEO long-tail.

name: TLL Magnus Moment v1
description: Highlighted aside about Magnus the polar-bear dog. Midnight card, teal rule, bone text. Moment text is a prop. Magnus always rendered with polar bear emoji.

name: TLL Sponsor Disclosure v1
description: FTC-style sponsored-content disclosure line. Muted bone card. Disclosure text is a prop.

name: TLL Site Footer
description: Canonical section-12 footer (brand, Navigate/Discover/Contribute/TLL columns, cookie prefs link, social). Used site-wide.
